document_role: Versioned declaration compiled from existing records; not a new preregistration

primary_metric.name: RMSE
primary_metric.scale: Original unannualized sigma7 units after inverse target scaling
primary_metric.aggregation: Pooled evaluation dates per model/history/seed, then mean and sample SD across seeds

secondary_metrics: MAPE with strictly positive targets and reported coverage
MASE with permitted-training calendar lag1 scale

original_operational_margin.reference: Deterministic persistence on the same eligible dates
original_operational_margin.timing: Documented before the first project DL fit and reserved-test evaluation, after development EDA
original_operational_margin.limit: Not a validated financial tolerance; not power for proving a gain above5percent; not automatically a margin between two networks

future_academic_margin.estimand: 1 - E[seed RMSE advanced]/E[seed RMSE reference]; boundary difference=.95*RMSEreference-RMSEadvanced
future_academic_margin.timing: Defined after the current test, for future independent comparisons only

units.observation: Daily UTC outcome; adjacent sigma7 labels share six returns
units.training_randomness: Ten paired training seeds4101..4110, conditional on the observed calendar
units.temporal_uncertainty: Shared chronological dates and temporal blocks; days/months/seeds do not create independent markets

partition.final_development_fit: Permitted2023-2024 outcomes with D-day purge before test
partition.split_rule: Chronological deterministic, no shuffled partition; no partition seed applies
partition.embargo: Equal to maximum covariate lag D under guide6.4
partition.CV: Actual timeseries-cv daily forward indices grouped into twelve monthly training/validation blocks
partition.test: 120 models frozen before first modeling access; twenty reporting months, zero refits
